newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe bids for investment at London conference.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe bids for investment at London conference.

text.p: Zimbabwe plans to present a transparent and outward-looking economy at its investment conference in London, the Confederation of Zimbabwe Industries (CZI) said on Wednesday.
The Zimbabwe Investment Conference will be held on March 5. President Robert Mugabe will lead the Zimbabwe delegation of business leaders and political representatives.

"The Zimbabwe delegation aims to fulfil two expectations for the British business community. Firstly, we will give a focused approach in our presentation. Secondly, our delegates will aim to give clarity on policy," CZI chairman Elias Ngugama said.
"We are offering a more open, outward, welcoming economic environment. We are accepting the need for transparency. We are offering a very attractive package of incentives," he added.
Ngugama cited the Export Processing Zone (EPZ) programme as an example of incentives for overseas investors.
The EPZ programme aims to increase the size of the manufacturing industry by offering benefits such as a five year tax break to companies exporting more than 80 percent of their products.
CZI is working closely with the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) to prepare the London conference, the second in three years.
